Electricity, Agricultural Productivity, and Deforestation: Evidence from Brazil
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economics (JAERE)
abstract: We examine the impact of improved access to electricity on deforestation through the incentives it creates for farms to switch from cattle grazing to croplands. We generate a model that elucidates the conditions under which increases in agricultural productivity can increase the incentives to intensify rather than expand land use and examine the predictions of that model using county-level data from five waves of the Brazilian Census of Agriculture and satellite-based measures of land use. We estimate the impact of rural electrification in Brazil from 1960 to 2000 and the resulting increases in agricultural productivity. We show that locations suitable for hydropower generation experienced improvements in crop yields incentivizing credit-constrained farmers to shift away from land-intensive cattle grazing and into cropping. As a result, agricultural land use declined, more native vegetation was protected, and these effects persist 25 years later in both census and satellite data.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了电力可及性的改善，通过激励农场从放牧转向耕地，对森林砍伐产生的影响。我们构建了一个模型，阐明在何种条件下，农业生产率的提高会增强集约化而非扩张土地利用的激励。我们利用巴西农业普查五轮的县级数据和基于卫星的土地利用测度，检验该模型的预测。我们估计了1960年至2000年间巴西农村电气化的影响，以及由此带来的农业生产率提高。我们表明，适宜水电发电的地区，其作物单产有所提高，从而激励受信贷约束的农民从占地密集的放牧转向种植。结果，农业用地减少，更多原生植被得以保留，并且这些效应在25年后的人口普查和卫星数据中依然存在。

The Productivity Consequences of Pollution-Induced Migration in China
abstract: Migration and pollution are two defining features of China's impressive growth performance over the last 30 years. In this paper we study the migration response to pollution in Chinese cities, and its consequences for productivity and welfare. We document a robust pattern in which skilled workers emigrate more in response to pollution than the unskilled. Their greater sensitivity to air quality holds up in cross-sectional variation across cities, panel variation with individual fixed-effects, and when instrumenting for pollution using distant power-plants upwind of cities, or thermal inversions that trap pollution. Pollution therefore changes the spatial distribution of skilled and unskilled workers, which results in higher returns to skill in cities that the educated migrate away from. We quantify the loss in aggregate productivity due to this re-sorting by estimating a model of demand and supply of skilled and unskilled workers across Chinese cities. Counterfactual simulations from the estimated model show that reducing pollution would increase productivity through spatial re-sorting by approximately as much as the direct health benefits of clean air. Physical and institutional restrictions on mobility exacerbate welfare losses. People's dislike of pollution explains a substantial portion of the wage gap between cities.
abstract_zh: 移民和污染是过去30年中国令人瞩目的增长表现的两个显著特征。本文研究中国城市中居民对污染的迁移反应，及其对生产率和福利的影响。我们记录了一个稳健的规律：相较于非技能工人，技能工人会因污染而更多地迁出。他们对空气质量更高的敏感性，在城市间的横截面差异、带个体固定效应的面板差异中均成立，并且在使用位于城市上风向远处的电厂，或能够困住污染物的热逆温作为污染工具变量时依然成立。因此，污染改变了技能工人与非技能工人的空间分布，导致受教育者迁离的城市中技能回报率上升。我们通过估计中国城市间技能工人和非技能工人供需的模型，量化了这种再分配所导致的总生产率损失。来自估计模型的反事实模拟表明，减少污染通过空间再分配所带来的生产率提升，与清洁空气直接带来的健康收益大致相当。对流动性的物理和制度限制加剧了福利损失。人们对污染的厌恶，解释了城市间工资差距的很大一部分。

COVID-19 through the Lens of Seasonal Agriculture in South Asia
abstract: 75% of the world's poor reside in rural areas where the local economy is tied to agriculture. We interpret new panel data on COVID‐19 from Nepal and Bangladesh in relation to agricultural seasonality. Conditions in April–June 2020 were comparable to a typical lean season even though the pandemic arrived at harvest time. Income losses stem from both depressed local employment as well as lower migration and remittances. We also document indirect adverse health impacts on nutrition and mental health. Findings are specific to the nature of economic activity at harvest, and effective pandemic policy must evolve with the agricultural season.
abstract_zh: 全球75%的贫困人口居住在农村地区，当地经济与农业紧密相连。我们结合农业季节性，解读了来自尼泊尔和孟加拉国的新的新冠疫情面板数据。尽管疫情恰逢收获期到来，但2020年4月至6月的状况与典型的农闲季节相当。收入损失既源于当地就业的萎缩，也源于外出务工人数和汇款的减少。我们还记录了对营养和心理健康的间接不利影响。研究结果取决于收获期经济活动的具体性质，有效的疫情政策必须随农业季节而演变。

Decentralization and Pollution Spillovers: Evidence from the Re-drawing of County Borders in Brazil
abstract: Decentralization can improve service delivery, but it can also generate externalities across jurisdictional boundaries. We examine the nature and size of water pollution externalities as rivers flow across jurisdictions. Panel data on water pollution in Brazilian rivers coupled with county splits that change the locations of borders allow us to identify the spatial patterns of pollution as rivers approach and cross borders, controlling for fixed effects and trends specific to each location. The theory of externalities predicts that pollution should increase at an increasing rate as the river approaches the downstream exit border, that there should be a structural break in the slope of the pollution function at the border, and that a larger number of managing jurisdictions should exacerbate pollution externalities. We find support for all four predictions in the data. Satellite data on growth in night-time lights along rivers show that local authorities allow more settlements to develop close to rivers in the downstream portions of counties, which is the likely underlying mechanism. The border effects on pollution are not as pronounced when the cost of inter-jurisdictional coordination is lower.
abstract_zh: 权力下放可以改善公共服务的提供，但它也可能跨越管辖边界产生外部性。随着河流流经不同管辖区，我们考察了水污染外部性的性质与规模。巴西河流水污染的面板数据，结合改变边界位置的县域分拆，使我们能够在控制各地固定效应和特定趋势的情况下，识别河流接近并穿越边界时污染的空间格局。外部性理论预测，随着河流接近下游出境边界，污染应以递增速率上升，边界处污染函数的斜率应出现结构性断点，而管辖主体数量越多，污染外部性应越严重。数据支持了所有四项预测。沿河夜间灯光增长的卫星数据表明，地方当局允许在县下游河段靠近河流的地方开发更多定居点，这很可能是潜在的作用机制。当跨管辖区协调成本较低时，边界对污染的影响则不那么明显。

title: Encouraging Sanitation Investment in the Developing World: A Cluster-Randomized Controlled Trial
abstract: Poor sanitation contributes to morbidity and mortality in the developing world, but there is disagreement on what policies can increase sanitation coverage. To measure the effects of alternative policies on investment in hygienic latrines, we assigned 380 communities in rural Bangladesh to different marketing treatments-community motivation and information; subsidies; a supply-side market access intervention; and a control-in a cluster-randomized trial. Community motivation alone did not increase hygienic latrine ownership (+1.6 percentage points, P = 0.43), nor did the supply-side intervention (+0.3 percentage points, P = 0.90). Subsidies to the majority of the landless poor increased ownership among subsidized households (+22.0 percentage points, P < 0.001) and their unsubsidized neighbors (+8.5 percentage points, P = 0.001), which suggests that investment decisions are interlinked across neighbors. Subsidies also reduced open defecation by 14 percentage points (P < 0.001).
abstract_zh: 卫生条件差会导致发展中国家的发病和死亡，但对于何种政策能够提高卫生设施覆盖率，人们存在分歧。为衡量不同政策对卫生厕所投资的效果，我们在孟加拉国农村将380个社区随机分配至不同的营销处理组：社区动员与信息提供、补贴、供给侧市场准入干预，以及对照组，并开展了整群随机试验。仅有社区动员并未提高卫生厕所的拥有率（+1.6个百分点，P=0.43），供给侧干预同样如此（+0.3个百分点，P=0.90）。向大多数无地贫困家庭提供补贴，提高了获补贴家庭的拥有率（+22.0个百分点，P<0.001），也提高了其未获补贴的邻居的拥有率（+8.5个百分点，P=0.001），这表明投资决策在邻里之间是相互关联的。补贴还使露天排便减少了14个百分点（P<0.001）。

Satellites, Self-reports, and Submersion: Exposure to Floods in Bangladesh
abstract: A burgeoning “Climate-Economy” literature has uncovered many effects of changes in temperature and precipitation on economic activity, but has made considerably less progress in modeling the effects of other associated phenomena, like natural disasters. We develop new, objective data on floods, focusing on Bangladesh. We show that rainfall and self-reported exposure are weak proxies for true flood exposure. These data allow us to study adaptation, giving accurate measures of both long-term averages and short term variation in exposure. This is important in studying climate change impacts, as people will not only experience new exposures, but also experience them differently.
abstract_zh: 大量“气候-经济”文献揭示了气温和降水变化对经济活动的诸多影响，但在建模其他相关现象（如自然灾害）的影响方面进展相对较少。我们以孟加拉国为研究对象，构建了关于洪水的新的客观数据。我们发现，降雨量和自我报告的暴露程度都是真实洪水暴露的较弱代理指标。这些数据使我们能够研究适应行为，并准确衡量长期平均暴露水平和短期暴露波动。这对于研究气候变化影响至关重要，因为人们不仅会面临新的暴露，还会以不同的方式经历这些暴露。

Gender Differences in Preferences, Intra-household Externalities and Low Demand for Improved Cookstoves
abstract: This paper examines whether an intra-household externality prevents adoption of a technology with substantial implications for population health and the environment: improved cookstoves. Motivated by a model of intra-household decision-making, the experiment markets stoves to husbands or wives in turn at randomly varying prices. We find that women -who bear disproportionate cooking costs -have stronger preference for healthier stoves, but lack the authority to make purchases. Our findings suggest that if women cannot make independent choices about household resource use, public policy may not be able to exploit gender differences in preferences to promote technology adoption absent broader social change.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了家庭内部外部性是否阻碍了某项对人口健康和环境具有重大影响的技术的采用：改良炉灶。基于家庭内部决策的模型，实验以随机变化的价格，依次向丈夫或妻子推销炉灶。我们发现，承担着不成比例的烹饪成本的女性，对更健康炉灶的偏好更强，但她们缺乏做出购买决定的权威。我们的发现表明，如果女性不能就家庭资源的使用独立做出选择，那么在缺乏更广泛社会变革的情况下，公共政策可能无法利用性别间的偏好差异来促进技术采用。

The Transforming Power of Democracy: Regime Type and the Distribution of Electricity
abstract: Theory on democracy and its consequences turns on how democracy influences behavior among politicians and the citizenry. Ultimately, the literature seeks to determine who benefits under democratic rules. This is our concern, posed in a context that allows us to address a classic question: does democracy favor large but diffuse segments of society over small but concentrated interests? We employ sectoral electricity consumption data for a panel of 733 country-years to examine democracy's impact on the distribution of electricity across three sectors that represent distinct political interests: industry, agriculture, and residential consumers. We find that in poorer countries democratization produces significant increases in the residential share of electricity relative to industry, suggesting sectors with less per capita financial clout, but a stronger voice in elections benefit under democracy. Unlike the large literatures on democracy's impact on theamountsof publicly provided goods, our results are among the first on thedistributionof those goods.
abstract_zh: 关于民主及其后果的理论，关注的是民主如何影响政治家和公民的行为。归根结底，该文献试图判断在民主规则下谁受益。这正是我们关注的问题，我们在一个能够回答经典问题的背景下提出了它：民主是否偏向于规模庞大但分散的社会群体，而非规模较小但高度集中的利益群体？我们利用733个国家-年面板的分部门电力消费数据，考察民主对三个代表不同政治利益的部门（工业、农业和居民用户）之间电力分配的影响。我们发现，在较贫穷的国家，民主化使居民部门相对于工业的电力份额显著提高，这表明人均财务影响力较弱、但在选举中发声更强的部门，在民主制下能够获益。与关于民主对公共物品供给数量影响的大量文献不同，我们的结果是最早关于这些公共物品分配的研究之一。

Progress on Sanitation in Rural India 2012-2021: Reconciling Diverse Evidence
abstract: The Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin (SBM-G) was launched by the Prime Minister of India in 2014 during his inaugural independence-day address, as a flagship program to eliminate open defecation in India by 2019. Touted as the world’s largest sanitation initiative, the program received global acclaim for its impressive achievements but the extent of progress it achieved in reducing open defecation has been the subject of much public debate. This paper assembles all available large-scale, nationally representative data sources to empirically evaluate India’s progress on sanitation coverage between 2012 and 2021. The lack of uniformity in the measurement of sanitation outcomes across surveys adds to the confusion around SBM-G achievements, leading to competing, mutually inconsistent claims. After harmonizing definitions and measurements across all data sources, we report four main results. First, there was enormous expansion in toilet access during the SBM-G period, and “coverage” in terms of sanitation infrastructure is nearly universal. Second, there was significant increase in regular toilet use, especially for the poor and the socially disadvantaged groups, but usage is far from universal. Third, there was wide spatial variation in progress across and within states. Finally, the substantial gains in regular toilet use between 2014 and 2019 have slowed or are reversing in most states, and particularly amongst marginalized households. Sustaining regular toilet use remains a critical challenge, and results from randomized controlled trials conducted by social scientists in several developing countries offer insights on how to sustainably increase sanitation demand.
abstract_zh: “清洁印度使命—农村”（SBM-G）于2014年由印度总理在其首次独立日演讲中宣布启动，作为一项旗舰计划，旨在于2019年前在印度消除露天排便。该计划被誉为世界最大的卫生行动，其令人瞩目的成就赢得了全球赞誉，但其在减少露天排便方面所取得的进展程度，一直是公众广泛争论的话题。本文汇集了所有可得的大规模、具有全国代表性的数据来源，以实证评估2012年至2021年间印度在卫生设施覆盖率方面的进展。各项调查在卫生结果衡量上缺乏统一性，加剧了关于SBM-G成就的混乱，并产生了相互竞争、彼此不一致的说法。在统一所有数据来源的定义和衡量方法之后，我们报告了四项主要结果。第一，在SBM-G期间，厕所可及性大幅扩大，就卫生基础设施而言，“覆盖”几乎已达到普及。第二，经常使用厕所的情况显著增加，尤其是在贫困和社会弱势群体中，但使用率远未普及。第三，各邦之间及邦内部的进展存在广泛的空间差异。最后，2014年至2019年间经常使用厕所的大幅增长，在大多数邦已经放缓或出现逆转，在边缘化家庭中尤为明显。维持经常性的厕所使用仍是一项严峻挑战，而社会科学家在若干发展中国家开展的随机对照试验，为如何可持续地提高卫生需求提供了启示。

How Climate Shocks Produce Armed Rebellion: The 1970 Bhola Cyclone and the Birth of Bangladesh
abstract: Why do climate shocks produce conflict (Hsiang et al., 2013)? We study the 1970 Bhola cyclone in East Pakistan, one of the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history, which killed an estimated 350,000 people. Using satellite imagery, archival records, electoral returns, and insurgent biographies, we show that cyclone exposure amplified pre-existing separatist sentiment at the ballot box and increased citizens’ subsequent participation in guerrilla warfare against the state. Our estimates imply that exposure to the cyclone’s devastation induced an additional 48,613 insurgents to join the guerrilla war effort. Effects are larger in areas with pre-existing political and economic grievances and weaker relief provision. Our analysis reveals the step-by-step mechanisms through which environmental shocks can produce conflict: they shift voting behavior, expose state indifference, and convert grievance into armed mobilization. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 为什么气候冲击会引发冲突（Hsiang等，2013）？我们研究了1970年东巴基斯坦的博拉气旋，它是有记录以来最致命的自然灾害之一，估计造成35万人死亡。利用卫星影像、档案记录、选举结果以及叛乱者的个人传记，我们表明，气旋暴露放大了选票中既有的分离主义情绪，并增加了公民随后参与反对国家的游击战争的程度。我们的估计表明，气旋造成的毁灭性冲击使另外48613名叛乱分子加入了游击战。在既有政治和经济不满更为严重、救济供给更为薄弱的地区，效应更大。我们的分析揭示了环境冲击引发冲突的逐步机制：它们改变投票行为，暴露国家的漠视，并将不满转化为武装动员。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可以在www.nber.org免费下载本文。
